attacks.description: Coordinated False Data Injection on SCADA measurements to bypass Bad Data Detection in WLS state estimation.
attacks.mitigation: GNN anomaly scoring, PMU cross-validation, RTU stream isolation, WLS re-estimation.

attacks.description: Flood attack on substation communication channels causing packet drop > 35% and loss of PMU sync lock.
attacks.mitigation: SCADA firewall rate limiting, secondary out-of-band link failover, local relay autonomous control.

attacks.description: Adversary sends unauthorized trip commands to substation circuit breakers causing uncontrolled line disconnection.
attacks.mitigation: Credential revocation, tie-switch automated closing, N-1 stability verification.

attacks.description: Adversary captures and replays stale synchrophasor measurements to mask real-time grid disturbances.
attacks.mitigation: PMU timestamp validation, sequence number verification, anomaly detection on measurement staleness.

attacks.description: Adversary modifies setpoints or thresholds in Energy Management System to cause suboptimal or dangerous dispatch.
attacks.mitigation: Setpoint change audit logging, dual-approval authorization, automated revert on constraint violation.
